arguments.command:
export DRIVE_TARGET=linux; export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG:-nothingness_linux_debug}"; export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}.log"; D=.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py; TARGET=$(python3 - <<'PY'
import json
with open('.tmp/inspect_queue_next.json') as f: d=json.load(f)
info=d['playback']['songInfo']
pos=info.get('position'); dur=info.get('duration')
print(min(dur-5000, pos+25000))
PY
); echo "Seeking to $TARGET ms"; $D seek "$TARGET"; sleep 2; $D inspect > .tmp/inspect_queue_seek2.json; echo '--- inspect after seek2 ---'; cat .tmp/inspect_queue_seek2.json; $D shoot after_fast_forward2 > /tmp/shot_after_fast_forward2.json; echo done
